items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Roll up that old King B, ready for the next tune.

ctx.x: When you guys did that? They saved their lip, that wifey. Now having a long job. You fall asleep during the numbers.
Roll up that old King B, ready for the next tune.

I hear a trumpet player that I worked, right up around Tuscaloosa, Alabama, one night in Birmingham. He got pretty loaded and, uh, he went to sleep while we were playing, uh, uh, loud up-tempo number. So they let him sleep and they woke him up in the middle of the next number, which was, uh, one, if you pardon the expression, a belly-rubbing number. So he jumped up and he started playing this real hot, loud bass number right in the middle of the slow one. They told him to shut up and he sat back down and went to…
